content.title: Eid al-Fitr brings end of Ramadan. See Columbus Eid prayer times, locations
content.text: Eid al-Fitr commemorates the end of Ramadan, the holiest month on the Islamic calendar.With Saudi Arabian observatories confirming the date of Eid al-Fitr 2026, nearly 2 billion Muslims worldwide and the roughly 1% of Ohioans who are Muslim will commemorate the end of Ramadan with a celebration called Eid al-Fitr, which is to fall on March 20. Muslims will hug their friends and family and greet them with “Eid Mubarak,” meaning “blessed festival” in Arabic.Looking for Eid prayer locations in Columbus? Find one near you below.Eid al-Fitr prayer times and locations in Columbus, OhioMuslims fast during daylight hours throughout Ramadan, abstaining from food and drink from dawn until sunset. Every day, they focus on God-consciousness, self-reflection, and self-improvement. Eid is a time of prayer and celebration, and Columbus, Ohio, has multiple locations hosting gatherings.Noor Islamic Cultural CenterDate: March 20Location: Greater Columbus Convention Center, Hall A, 400 N. High Street, ColumbusTakbeer: 8:30 a.m.Salat: 9:00 a.m.Prayer will NOT be at any of the NICC locations. More information can be found on the website.Polaris Masjid Islamic Center of Delaware CountyDate: March 20Address: Bill McDonald Athletic ComplexFirst Eid Salah: 8:30 amSecond Eid Salah: 10:30 amPrayer will NOT be at Polaris Masjid Islamic Center. More information can be found on the center's Instagram.Masjid Ibnu Taymiyah and Islamic CenterDate: March 20Address: 2334 Mock Road, ColumbusTakbeerat: 7 a.m.First prayer: 8 a.m.Second prayer: 9 a.m.More information can be found on the center's Facebook page.Masjid OmarDate: March 20Address: 580 Riverview Dr, ColumbusFirst Takbeerat: 8 a.m. (English)Second Takbeerat: 9 a.m. (English)Third Takbeerat: 10 a.m. (Arabic)More information can be found on the masjid website.Muslim American Society ColumbusDate: March 20Address: 4615 Northtowne Blvd, ColumbusFirst Prayer: 8:30 a.m.Second Prayer: 9:30 a.m.Third Prayer: 10:30 a.m.More information can be found on the society's Instagram page.This story will be updated with more Eid prayer locations in Columbus.
